holdings.name: Sobha Ltd

what_changed.text: Sobha reported Q2 FY27 sales bookings rose 16% year-on-year to ₹22.06 billion, bringing first-half sales to a record ₹58.62 billion.
For the quarter ended June 2026, the company posted sales of ₹1,278 crore and net profit of ₹51 crore.

expected.text: Sobha was expected to beat its FY27 pre-sales guidance after reporting a record first-half performance.

seeing.text: Recorded H1 pre-sales of ₹5,862 crore confirmed record sales traction relative to pre-sales targets.

holdings.why_it_matters: Sobha is the fund's largest position at 2.30% weight. Its -18.71% 3-month decline made it the portfolio's biggest performance drag, detracting an estimated -0.43% within the 5% Real Estate allocation.

watch.text: The board meeting on October 19, 2026 to approve Q2 and half-year financial results.

holdings.name: REC Ltd

what_changed.text: REC received a No Objection Certificate from the Reserve Bank of India for its proposed scheme of merger with Power Finance Corporation.
The company divested transmission subsidiary Nawada Durgapur Power Transmission for ₹18.45 crore, following the transfer of two project SPVs for approximately ₹8.4 crore each.
REC incorporated three wholly owned subsidiaries for transmission projects in Bikaner and Mirzapur.
REC was among the top midcap stocks seeing mutual fund selling in September 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.13% weight, REC fell -13.32% over 3 months, contributing an estimated -0.284% drag to fund performance amidst broader weakness in Financials.

watch.text: Further regulatory and scheme approvals required to complete the merger with Power Finance Corporation.

holdings.name: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Ltd

what_changed.text: For the quarter ended June 2026, revenue increased to ₹11,114 crore and net profit rose to ₹1,789 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 1.90% fund weight, the stock dropped -13.57% over 3 months, generating an estimated -0.258% drag on fund returns.

watch.text: The board meeting on November 6, 2026 to review unaudited results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026.

holdings.name: LT Foods Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 quarterly sales reached ₹3,152 crore with a net profit of ₹183 crore.
CRISIL assigned LT Foods an ESG rating of 61 in the strong performance category for FY 2025-26.
The company changed the name of its wholly owned subsidiary to KLT Foods (India) Private Limited on October 14, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Weighing 1.81%, LT Foods posted a 9.06% 3-month return, providing positive cushion within the fund's 4.3% Consumer Staples allocation.

watch.text: The board meeting scheduled for October 27, 2026 to consider Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: State Bank of India revised its lending interest rates across EBLR and RLLR benchmarks.
SBI purchased nearly 40% of Reliance's $1.35 billion debt offering in late September 2026.
Quarterly net profit for June 2026 reached ₹25,121 crore on revenue of ₹136,240 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 1.75% of the fund, SBI declined -7.82% over the last 3 months, adding to the negative returns across the 22.1% Financials basket.

watch.text: The impact of revised lending rates on net interest margins and loan demand.

holdings.name: Cyient Ltd

what_changed.text: Chief Operating Officer Prabhakar Atla resigned with effect from September 28, 2026.
Quarter ended June 2026 sales came in at ₹2,076 crore with operating profit of ₹263 crore.
Subsidiary Cyient DLM reported a 26% growth in normalised PAT to ₹15.82 crore for Q2 FY27.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 1.62% weight, Cyient surged 39.89% over 3 months, delivering the second-highest positive contribution of an estimated +0.646% to the fund.

watch.text: The board meeting on October 22, 2026 to approve Q2 FY27 results and consider an interim dividend.

holdings.name: The South Indian Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: The bank reported Q2 FY27 net profit of ₹426 crore on revenue of ₹2,796 crore, up from ₹378 crore in the preceding quarter.
MCLR rates across tenors were revised effective October 20, 2026.
The bank designated SIB Tower in Kakkanad as its corporate office and announced senior management changes across four executive roles.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 1.55% of the portfolio, the bank gained 15.36% over 3 months, delivering an estimated +0.238% positive contribution to the fund.

watch.text: The operational effect of revised MCLR benchmarks effective October 20, 2026.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: HDFC Bank reported Q2 net profit grew approximately 4.7% to 5% year-on-year to ₹19,510 crore, with net interest income rising 10% while margins touched record lows.
Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha will step down on December 31, 2026.

expected.text: Analysts held mixed expectations for Q2 profit, with results cited as broadly meeting estimates by some and trailing estimates by others.

seeing.text: Reported net profit of ₹19,510 crore rose 4.7%, but margins were pressured at record lows and treasury income dropped 67%.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 1.46% fund allocation, the bank declined -11.07% over 3 months, amplifying the broad drag from financial holdings.

watch.text: Leadership transition as Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha demits office on December 31, 2026.

holdings.name: Arvind Ltd

what_changed.text: Arvind completed the acquisition of a 46% stake in Arvind GCC Private Limited on October 6, 2026.
CARE upgraded credit ratings for subsidiary Arvind Envisol's bank facilities to CARE A-/A2+.
June 2026 quarterly results showed sales of ₹2,501 crore and net profit of ₹58 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 1.43% weight, Arvind fell -1.91% over 3 months, consolidating after strong 6-month (+35.93%) and 1-year (+70.32%) gains in Consumer Discretionary.

watch.text: Performance and integration updates from the acquired 46% interest in Arvind GCC.

holdings.name: Jubilant Pharmova Ltd

what_changed.text: The board approved raising up to ₹800 crore via NCDs and sought shareholder approval to expand borrowing powers to ₹2,500 crore.
ICRA assigned an [ICRA]AA+ (Stable) rating to proposed ₹1,400 crore NCDs.
Its radiopharma unit committed CAD 94.5 million to double RUBY-FILL capacity, backed by CAD 23.8 million in Canadian federal support.
Quant Mutual Fund offloaded a stake worth over ₹100 crore through block deals.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 1.40% of the portfolio, Jubilant Pharmova fell -8.21% over 3 months, reflecting pressure from institutional block sales within the 8.9% Healthcare allocation.

watch.text: Shareholder voting on the ₹2,500 crore borrowing limit and the closure of the ₹800 crore NCD issue.

portfolio.statement: BANDHAN Small Cap Fund manages ₹35,856 crore in AUM with an 86.4% equity exposure, 13.5% held in cash and others, and a 17.4% concentration across its top 10 holdings.
interp: The fund posted a 3-month gain of 1.76% and a 1-year return of 9.98%, with small-cap stock winners balancing heavy detractions from real estate and NBFCs.
Financials forms the largest sector at 22.1%, where rate resets and merger developments have coincided with broad quarterly price declines.
portfolio.line: Gains in technology and select regional banks offset substantial drops in top real estate and power finance holdings.

drivers.text: Cyient delivered a 39.89% 3-month return, contributing an estimated +0.646% to the fund.
The South Indian Bank advanced 15.36% over 3 months, contributing an estimated +0.238% after Q2 profit rose to ₹426 crore.
Sobha dropped -18.71% over 3 months, detracting an estimated -0.43% despite record H1 booking updates.
REC declined -13.32% over 3 months, resulting in an estimated -0.284% drag amid mutual fund selling.
